rows.text: returns without writing when the qword at `02EBB7F0` is null; otherwise addresses the 0x180-byte entry at sign-extended `ecx` times 0x180 from that qword and copies its dword `+0x10` to `02EBB7F8`, dword `+0x14` to `02EBB7FC` and dword `+0x1C` to `02EBB804`

notes: 003ED7B0: stride 0x180 is (ecx*3) << 7. ecx is not bounds-checked.
